div.div: RC step response with swept R
Parameters (PARAMS button): Rv swept 1k..100k (2 points per decade), Cv = 10n.
Measurement trise = 10% to 90% rise time of V(n002); expected 2.2 Rv Cv.
RUN draws one curve per Rv. Measurement Report: plot of trise over Rv (log x).
